+"""Ordered includes."""
+
+import os
+
+from lamina.errors import IncludeError
+
+
+def resolve_ordered_include(base_dir: str, name: str, root: str, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    """Resolve a ordered include relative to base_dir, confined to root."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(name)
+    root_real = os.path.realpath(root)
+    resolved_path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(base_dir, name))
+    if os.path.commonpath([resolved_path, root_real]) != root_real:
+        raise IncludeError(f"include escapes the project root: {name}", 0, 1)
+    if not os.path.isfile(resolved_path):
+        raise IncludeError(f"include not found: {name}", 0, 1)
+    return resolved_path
+
+
+def read_ordered_include(base_dir: str, name: str, root: str) -> str:
+    """Return the text of a ordered include."""
+    path = resolve_ordered_include(base_dir, name, root)
+    with open(path) as fh:
+        return fh.read()

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.include.ordered import resolve_ordered_include, read_ordered_include
+
+
+def test_ordered_include_reads_file(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "base.conf").write_text("[a]\nx = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "x = 1" in read_ordered_include(str(tmp_path), "base.conf", str(tmp_path))
+
+
+def test_ordered_include_missing(tmp_path):
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        resolve_ordered_include(str(tmp_path), "nope.conf", str(tmp_path))
